bihar_raw_news.title: Canada tightens immigration rules , imposes fines of up to CAD 1.5 million
bihar_raw_news.content: Synopsis Canada has established new penalties for unauthorized immigration and citizenship advice, which will come into effect in 2026. Individuals providing paid immigration services must have proper authorization to avoid financial penalties. The penalties will range from CAD 5,000 for unauthorized advice to CAD 1.5 million for serious violations. Employers and applicants are advised to verify representative credentials and accuracy of information submitted. Listen to this article in summarized format Listen iStock Canada has introduced monetary penalties of up to CAD 1.5 million for violations involving unauthorised immigration and citizenship advice. The penalties also involve misrepresentation and deliberate submission of false or misleading information. The new rules, which came into effect on October 28, 2026, apply to both authorised and unauthorised representatives providing paid immigration or citizenship services, according to a Fragomen report. The penalties also cover individuals operating outside Canada. Also Read: US visa, green card applicants: What changed under USCIS filing deadline rules from October 23 Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) will also publish the names of penalised representatives and details of their violations in a public registry expected to be launched in 2027, on its official website. What do the new rules say? Under the new framework, individuals providing paid immigration or citizenship advice or representation without proper authorisation can face a fine of CAD 5,000. Also, individuals who knowingly provide false or misleading information on behalf of an applicant, or help an applicant submit such information, can face penalties of CAD 15,000. Also Read: Australia to tighten visa rules from October 31, with tougher character checks Additional penalties may apply if an immigration application is approved on the basis of false or misleading information. The amount of the penalty will depend on the seriousness and frequency of the violation, with the maximum amount reaching CAD 1.5 million for all violations combined. The rules cover paid representatives, including licensed immigration consultants, lawyers and other authorised representatives, as well as those offering such services without the required authorisation. What does this mean for employers and applicants? Employers managing immigration processes internally have been advised to review the activities of their teams and assess whether they require an authorised representative. Internal employees providing paid immigration advice or representation without the necessary authorisation could also face financial penalties and public disclosure of their violations. Employers and foreign nationals have also been advised to verify the credentials and authorisation of their immigration representatives and ensure that all information submitted as part of an application is accurate. bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar Museum in world's top 10, beats New York's Met and Louvre in Paris
bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar Museum in world’s top 10, beats New York’s Met and Louvre in Paris; Anand Mahindra calls it ‘game changer’ The list, published by Munich-based travel magazine Worth a Journey, also ranks the Patna museum first in Asia. Moneycontrol City Desk October 30, 2026 / 11:11 IST The Bihar Museum in Patna has been ranked ninth on the “World’s 100 Best Museums 2026” list, ahead of global giants such as the Louvre in Paris and New York’s Metropolitan Museum of Art. The list, published by Munich-based travel magazine Worth a Journey, also ranks the Patna museum first in Asia. It is the only Indian museum in the top 100. The rankings are based on visitor reviews, data analytics and on-site evaluations by experts. This is a seminal moment of recognition. To have the Bihar Museum in Patna ranked 9th globally and the best in Asia is simply staggering. And it has the potential to be a game changer for the museum-going experience in India. Because it raises the bar for EVERY museum that exists in this country, and every museum yet to be built. A new gold standard. What makes this achievement even more remarkable is the story behind it. Conceived and championed by former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, & brought to life through the sustained efforts of the Bihar government and committed administrators. A great example of vision, administrative determination and world-class creative collaboration. The biggest beneficiaries will be the Indian public, who have long deserved museum experiences comparable to those they queue up for when travelling overseas. A standing ovation for EVERYONE who had a hand in making the Bihar Museum a reality. May this be the beginning of a museum renaissance in India… 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽 — anand mahindra (@anandmahindra) October 29, 2026 Reacting on X, Mahindra Group chairman Anand Mahindra called it “a seminal moment of recognition,” and said it could be a game changer for the museum-going experience in India. Related Stories Bengaluru's Museum of Innovation, Startup & Technology to be designed by architects behind Grand Egy... Banana from multimillion-dollar artwork goes missing, French museum files complaint Karnataka approves AI Centre of Excellence in Electronics City; Transfer of 51% stake in Technology ... The ranking took many in the art world by surprise, given that the Bihar Museum is barely a decade old. The museum’s ‘Mona Lisa’ The Bihar Museum may not have the Mona Lisa, but it has its own showpiece: the Didarganj Yakshi, according to TOI. The life-sized, 2,000-year-old statue is carved from a single block of highly polished Chunar sandstone and stands in an air-conditioned room. Though her nose is chipped and her left arm broken, she holds a fly-whisk (chauri) in her hand. Spread over 13.9 acres, the museum also houses the famed Kurkihar bronzes, prehistoric stone tools, and a Kushan-period slab depicting the birth of the Buddha, the report said. Satyam Sundaram took the monetary aid under the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) to kickstart his enterprise. Once plunged into neck-deep debt, the young graduate founded his own enterprise after the COVID-19 pandemic, with assistance from a Central government scheme, and today is running it successfully. His mother, who used to get shattered by the taunts of society, is now taking pride in her son’s success. After the COVID-19 pandemic, Satyam’s family was in deep trouble as they suffered a severe financial crunch, but he didn’t give up. Satyam began with a small venture selling bamboo-based products. Starting his venture with a Rs10 lakh loan under the PMEGP, his enterprise is thriving today and providing livelihoods to nearly 40 families. Satyam Sundaram’s father is a Class IV employee. Despite financial hardships, his family ensured that he got a good education. After completing his MBA, Satyam secured a job at ITC, but the 2020 COVID-19 pandemic changed the course of his life. Both his parents fell critically ill due to the virus. During this period, Satyam learnt that his company was laying off staff, and he, too, lost his job. He returned to Purnia and took on the responsibility of his parents' medical care. While his family eventually recovered, their entire savings had been exhausted by the medical expenses. Satyam did not lose heart. After reading about the PMEGP in a newspaper, he thought of starting his own business. He travelled to Assam and Manipur, purchased bamboo-based products for Rs3,000, and began selling them in the Purnia market. The entire stock sold out within four days, yielding a good profit. With a Rs10 lakh loan secured through the PMEGP, he launched the 'Manipuri Bamboo Architecture' company. Throughout this journey, Satyam’s mother, Asha Anuragini, stood by him at every step. When Satyam began his business of bamboo-based products, some people in society taunted him, questioning why an MBA graduate would pursue such work. However, his mother stood behind him. bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar Drinking Water Project Gets Rs 1,774 Crore Backing - Urban Acres
bihar_raw_news.content: Home Breaking News Bihar Drinking Water Project Wins Rs 1,774 Crore NABARD Backing Breaking News Bihar Drinking Water Project Wins Rs 1,774 Crore NABARD Backing By Maria Dsouza October 30, 2026 0 Copy URL Facebook Linkedin X WhatsApp Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary has announced a Rs 2,014 crore drinking water project for Aurangabad, Sasaram and Dehri, with Rs 1,774 crore approved by NABARD to upgrade water infrastructure under the Rural Infrastructure Development Fund. The scheme will use surface water from the Sone river to strengthen existing supply systems in the three towns. The announcement was made by the chief minister on Thursday, according to a statement from the Chief Minister’s Office. Choudhary said the project would expand drinking water facilities and improve water availability in the three areas. The state government said the scheme would initially serve a population of around 8 lakh. The project is expected to cover nearly 12 lakh people by 2051, indicating that the planned infrastructure is being designed around long-term population growth in the three towns. The announcement did not provide details of the proposed treatment capacity, distribution network, construction schedule, tendering process or commissioning date. The funding approved by NABARD is part of the Rural Infrastructure Development Fund, which supports infrastructure projects through institutional financing. The statement did not specify how the remaining amount from the total project cost would be financed or provide a town-wise allocation for Aurangabad, Sasaram and Dehri. The proposed use of Sone river water will reinforce existing drinking water systems rather than replace them, according to the chief minister’s statement. The announcement therefore links the project to both source augmentation and the strengthening of civic supply infrastructure. Details on water treatment facilities, transmission lines, storage arrangements and household-level connections were not included in the information released. Choudhary also linked the initiative to Bihar’s Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali campaign, which promotes water conservation, environmental protection and the sustainable use of water resources. The project’s stated objective is to provide residents with clean and adequate drinking water while expanding the capacity of urban and surrounding supply systems. The announcement places the three towns within a wider state effort to improve basic infrastructure with support from the Union government and financial institutions. For residents, the eventual impact will depend on how quickly the approved funding is converted into construction, treatment and distribution capacity, as well as how the expanded network is operated and maintained. The Bihar government has not yet announced the project’s implementation timeline, construction milestones or completion date. Further details are expected as the scheme moves from funding approval to execution. national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be on a two-day visit to Gujarat, beginning today. Mr Modi will lay the foundation stone, inaugurate and dedicate to the nation various development projects worth over 14 thousand crore rupees in Banaskantha today. The Prime Minister will lay the foundation stone of Ahmedabad Metro Phase-2A (Airport Extension) and Phase-2B (GIFT City Extension). He will also release the 24th instalment under PM-KISAN, amounting to 19 thousand crore rupees. He will also visit the Embryo Transfer Technology-In Vitro Fertilisation Laboratory and the Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre cattle farm in Banaskantha. The Centre will strengthen bovine breeding, genetic upgradation and advanced reproductive technologies, accelerating breed improvement by 10 to 20 times. Thereafter, the Prime Minister will travel to Ekta Nagar, Kevadia and inaugurate Bharat Parv 2026. Tomorrow, Prime Minister Modi will offer floral tributes at the Statue of Unity. Mr Modi will lay the foundation stone, inaugurate and dedicate to the nation various development projects worth over four hundred crore rupees in Ekta Nagar. The projects include a sewage and water treatment plant, facade lighting, the upgradation of Narmada Ghat, and the Rainforest, among others. The Prime Minister will also participate in the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations commemorating the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

national_raw_news.title: 14th International Tourism Mart inaugurated in Arunachal Pradesh's Tawang - ANI News
national_raw_news.content: 14th International Tourism Mart inaugurated in Arunachal Pradesh's Tawang Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर 14th International Tourism Mart inaugurated in Arunachal Pradesh's Tawang ANI | Updated: Oct 30, 2026 03:59 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 30 (ANI): The 14th edition of the International Tourism Mart (ITM), organised by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, in association with the Government of Arunachal Pradesh and other North Eastern States, commenced on Thursday at Tawang , Arunachal Pradesh . The three-day Mart, being held from October 29 to 31, aims to showcase the tourism potential of the eight North Eastern States and strengthen business engagement with domestic and international tourism markets. The inaugural session was held in the presence of Gajendra Singh Shekhawat , Union Minister for Tourism and Culture; Suresh Gopi, Union Minister of State for Tourism and Petroleum & Natural Gas; Sukanta Majumdar, Union Minister of State for Education and Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER); Pema Khandu, Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh ; and Prem Singh Tamang, Chief Minister of Sikkim. Tourism Ministers from the North Eastern States, senior officials of the Central and State Governments, international and domestic tourism stakeholders and representatives of the travel industry were also present. Addressing the inaugural session, Union Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat emphasised that the International Tourism Mart has evolved beyond a promotional platform into an important avenue for tourism partnerships and business opportunities. He stated, “ITM is not merely a tourism marketplace; it is a platform for building partnerships, generating business opportunities and creating a shared vision for the growth of tourism in the North East Region.” Highlighting the immense potential of the region, the Minister said that its rich biodiversity, cultural heritage, spiritual traditions and natural landscapes offer distinctive opportunities for adventure, nature-based and experiential tourism. He particularly emphasised the potential of adventure tourism, music festivals and concert tourism to attract new visitor segments, encourage longer stays and generate economic opportunities for local communities. He also called for developing tourism experiences with appropriate safety standards, community participation and environmental safeguards. The Minister highlighted the Government’s continued focus on improving connectivity, tourism infrastructure and destination experiences in the North Eastern Region. He also underlined the Ministry’s support for tourism promotion through domestic and international travel fairs, festivals, digital platforms and familiarisation visits, along with skill development initiatives to create employment opportunities for local youth. national_raw_news.content: India Post, UTI Mutual Fund extend partnership for doorstep KYC verification across India | Business About Career Advertisement Media Partnership Contact Us HOME NEWS RESEARCH LIVE DISCOURSE PERSPECTIVES AND INSIGHTS SUBMIT PRESS RELEASE NEWS DESK RESEARCH LIVE DISCOURSE PERSPECTIVES AND INSIGHTS INTERVIEW Home News Law & Governance Article India Post, UTI Mutual Fund extend partnership for doorstep KYC verification across India India Post and UTI Mutual Fund have extended their existing partnership to expand doorstep Know Your Customer (KYC) verification services for mutual fund investors across India, particularly in remote and underserved areas. ANI | Updated: 29-10-2026 21:10 IST | Created: 29-10-2026 21:10 IST Senior officials from the Department of Posts and UTI AMC during the meeting at UTI AMC’s Corporate Office (Photo/PIB). Image Credit: ANI SHARE Key Takeaways AI Summary Analyzing article... India Post and UTI Mutual Fund have extended their existing partnership to expand doorstep Know Your Customer (KYC) verification services for mutual fund investors across India, particularly in remote and underserved areas. According to a release issued by the Ministry of Communications on Thursday, the expanded collaboration aims to simplify investor verification, improve access to mutual fund services and strengthen financial inclusion. "Under the Pan-India KYC Verification Project, India Post will leverage its extensive postal network and last-mile connectivity to facilitate Know Your Customer (KYC) verification at investors' doorsteps, including in remote and underserved areas," the ministry said. The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) extending the existing agreement was signed by Adnan Ahmed, Chief General Manager, Parcel & CCS Directorate, Department of Posts, and Vetri Subramaniam, Managing Director and CEO of UTI Asset Management Company Limited, in Mumbai on Thursday. The expanded partnership builds on an earlier KYC remediation initiative that helped investors complete pending verification requirements and address documentation gaps. "Building on the earlier KYC remediation initiative, which helped investors complete pending KYC requirements, improve compliance and address documentation gaps, the expanded collaboration is expected to strengthen investor servicing, encourage wider participation in mutual funds and support uninterrupted access to mutual fund investments," the release stated. India Post has already been providing doorstep KYC verification services for mutual fund investors. According to an earlier Ministry of Communications release issued in April 2025, India Post had completed over 5 lakh KYC verifications for UTI and the Specified Undertaking of the Unit Trust of India (SUUTI). The Department of Posts subsequently signed similar agreements with Nippon India Mutual Fund in April 2025 and SBI Mutual Fund later that month. In July 2025, India Post also entered into an agreement with the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) to facilitate KYC verification for mutual fund investors through its network of over 1.64 lakh post offices.
